decisions_log.notes: 3 files. B-1: MAX_REPORT_ISSUES_PER_VARIANT=200 caps _declaration_error_lines with the cut STATED in the document (matching the module's region/hexdump discipline). Counterfactual EXECUTED: cap=200 -> 200 lines + '> TRUNCATED:'; cap removed -> 300 lines, no marker, TC-397 RED. Fixture is 1.5x the cap and says so in its docstring (batch-60 lesson). B-2: REPORT_CELL_CHARS pinned by a boundary pair on descriptor.path.name - file-derived, in a table cell, NO upstream cap, so it is the field a cap can silently truncate; 512 survives verbatim, 513 truncates, both directions bite. All 5 TC gaps closed. TC-382's gap was ONE-SIDED: the battery had only characters that must be DROPPED, so an over-broad 'drop anything category-C-ish' filter would have passed - the new cases pin what must SURVIVE (NBSP is Zs, combining acute is Mn); its size case is ~2.1MB (~8750x the cap) replacing a 10k-char case three orders of magnitude under anything interesting. INC-5 CAUGHT A DEFECT IN ITSELF: TC-389's first draft asserted '"](" not in note' and FAILED against a correct implementation, because the escaped form is '\](' - ']' is escaped and '(' needs none once the brackets are dead. That is this batch's own recurring defect (assert the token stream, not a character list) committed inside its own census; replaced with a token-set assertion and recorded in the test docstring. Also self-corrected: the validation artifact first stated 2205 passed, written from targeted runs BEFORE the full suite returned 2207 - corrected against the run and the correction left visible. m-1 partially closed: 7 TCs now traceable by node NAME; the other 16 stay covered by consolidated batteries with the mapping in 04-validation.md section 3, and the reverse-index control stays a project-wide backlog item rather than being invented unilaterally here. Suite 2168 -> 2207 (+39), 0 regressions, ruff clean, frozen guards green.
